headline: Godawari Power And Ispat limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange intimation regarding incorporation of Godawari Energy Solutions Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Godawari Power and Ispat Limited on 17.10.2026.
